name: WHO GHO OData
tagline: World Health Organization Global Health Observatory indicators via OData
description: Public OData API for the World Health Organization Global Health Observatory, exposing health indicators, dimensions, and statistical data for countries and regions. Developers query indicator metadata and observation values with standard OData filter, select, and top operations—no authentication required for public read access.

auth.details: No authentication required for public read access to GHO OData endpoints.

use_cases: list WHO health indicators and codes
query GHO observation values for an indicator
filter health statistics by year or region
explore GHO dimension metadata for dashboards
